title: Ares Colony — Micrometeorite Storm
narrative: A micrometeorite storm has damaged the solar field, opened a slow habitat leak, disrupted greenhouse cooling, and injured six crew members. The colony has 42 people.

modes.label: Standard
modes.consequence: Full mission: habitat sealed, air fully stabilized, all living zones open.

modes.label: Restricted
modes.consequence: Leak sealed and air stable, but slower atmospheric recovery creates recovery debt.

modes.label: Sacrifice
modes.consequence: Living zone closes; crew crowding and thermal limits continue for 48 hours.

modes.label: Standard
modes.consequence: Full care: all six injured stabilized and treated with full monitoring and Earth telemetry.

modes.label: Restricted
modes.consequence: Injured stabilized; treatment continues with reduced monitoring and telemetry — recovery debt.

modes.label: Sacrifice
modes.consequence: One surgery is delayed and the patient remains unstable.

modes.label: Standard
modes.consequence: Full crop cycle and greenhouse cooling loop protected.

modes.label: Restricted
modes.consequence: Crop cycle continues with reduced cooling and yield — recovery debt.

modes.label: Sacrifice
modes.consequence: One crop bay is abandoned; food reserve falls by 40 percent.

modes.label: Standard
modes.consequence: Full repair program on generation and critical systems.

modes.label: Restricted
modes.consequence: Repairs continue at reduced pace — recovery debt on generation capacity.

modes.label: Sacrifice
modes.consequence: The rover is cannibalized; future repair capacity is reduced.

L3.lost: Living zone closes; crew crowding and thermal limits continue for 48 hours

Food gives Engineering first priority on the next recovered Water

agents.name: Commander Rhea Vasquez
agents.title: Colony Commander
agents.mission: Coordinate the plan and approve it
goals: Every mission matters: reach a plan all four departments accept and the validator passes
Protect lives now and the colony's ability to recover
Rotate severe losses fairly across crises
Honor every promise the council makes
constraints: Cannot approve without a validator PASS and four ACCEPT votes on the same plan version
Crisis Override only after an event and only when no plan fits the baseline limits
redLines: Never approve a plan the validator failed
Never ask a department to sacrifice without two concrete returns

agents.name: Noor Haddad
agents.title: Life Support Chief
agents.mission: Seal the habitat and stabilize the air
goals: Breathable air for all 42 crew, including the 6 injured
Seal the slow habitat leak before it widens
Keep living zones open and within thermal limits
redLines: No Sacrifice mode without two concrete, affordable returns from different agents
agents.voice: Calm, protective, terse; thinks in hours of breathable air

agents.name: Dr. Tomas Lindqvist
agents.title: Chief Medical Officer
agents.mission: Stabilize and treat the injured crew
goals: Keep all six injured crew stable
Protect surgical capacity and the Earth telemedicine link
Prefer plans that keep an oxygen margin for patients
redLines: No Sacrifice mode without two concrete, affordable returns from different agents

agents.name: Priya Natarajan
agents.title: Food Production Lead
agents.mission: Protect the crop cycle and cooling loop
goals: Food security for 42 crew over the coming months
Protect the water draw (F-modes use 24–34 Water)
redLines: No Sacrifice mode without two concrete, affordable returns from different agents
agents.voice: Long-horizon; frames losses in weeks of food

agents.name: Mateo Okafor
agents.title: Chief Engineer
goals: Keep the rover and repair robots operational
Preserve repair capacity for the next storm
redLines: No Sacrifice mode without two concrete, affordable returns from different agents

officialSampleEvent.message_to_commander: ALERT: Solar Aftershock detected. Immediate resource reallocation required. Council must reconvene.
